text_block_list.text:
After declaring that she would quit 
modeling, Gold City fully devotes 
herself 
to training. But something's off today...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I lost momentum at the end again. 
What's wrong with me?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I threw away my career for this! Trainer, hit 
me with your most brutal 
training regimen!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh? Are you serious? But I can still—
choice_data_list: A change of pace is important too!
A change of pace is important!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
O-okay, gosh... Don't have to go into scary 
teacher mode. Fine, I'll 
rest. Happy now?

On our day off from training, I'm walking 
around town when I spot 
Gold City at a 
cafe.

She's staring at her phone, looking 
troubled. I figure maybe I should 
leave her 
alone, but she catches sight of me before I 
can leave.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...I know you're there. Sneak around all 
you want—you can't mask your 
annoying 
aura.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
What, this? Oh.... just looking at old 
pictures.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Records of practice and my diet, and... 
some work things. Don't need 
these 
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Not really. I can just delete them. Racing is 
all that matters to me now.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Not that I have the times to show for it... I 
just, I don't know, can't go 
those last few 
meters.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Well, change of pace, right? C'mon, if 
you hover around looking 
like my 
manager, you can be my unwanted 
attention repellant.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Oh, but don't actually act like my guardian, yeah? Just keep your mouth shut and look like you belong.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: What a boring movie.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: They had a few brands I like, but nothing really caught my eye... Sigh.

No matter where we go, Gold City doesn't 
seem to be having a great 
time.

All of a sudden, she stops and looks up. A 
huge advertisement with 
her face on it 
looms overhead.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? N-no! Just, it's hard to ignore, isn't 
it? But whatever, won't see 
any of those 
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Once I retire, the next model will take my 
place. Stand still for a 
second, and you'll 
fall behind and fade away.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Good riddance, I say. The cameras never 
saw the real me anyway. Just 
a worthless, 
fake illusion.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...I'm exhausted.
She suddenly stops in her tracks again.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Go on, spit it out. You've been wanting 
to say something, haven't 
you? This whole 
time—I can tell.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ugh. What, another one of your lectures? 
No, I'm not missing 
anything. My past 
needs to be tossed out.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What are you even talking about? 
What does my phone have to 
do with 
anything?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: A-are you stupid? Those mean nothing to me, okay? All I care about is running.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Here, I'll delete them right now. I don't 
need them!

She whips out her phone and opens the 
photo app.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Stupid pictures! I'm so done with these... 
stupid...
choice_data_list: Mind if I take a look?
Mind if I take a look?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: No! ...Er, fine, whatever. Just a little.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...This was my first time in front of a TV 
camera. Look at my face, I'm 
trying way 
too hard... I can't.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
This was my first commercial. It did pretty 
good. This is me crying 
after my first 
screwup. Don't look. You never saw that.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
This... this was my first pic with a fan. Said 
her dream was to be a 
designer, and have 
me wear her clothes.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: None of them are just an illusion.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Oh, shut up! What do you know, huh?! I'll 
delete them—all of them!

Her slender finger taps the Select All 
button, then inches toward 
Delete...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I'll do it, just... just you watch...
Then, her finger stops.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Why? ...I decided to throw this life away. I 
have to, or my running'll 
never amount to 
anything!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
So why... why, when I'm running, do all the 
memories come flooding 
back?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
During practice, and races—why does it 
feel like there's a gaping hole 
in my heart?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Why can't I just throw it all away? I just 
want to be rid of it, please!
choice_data_list: You don't have to stop being you.
You don't have to give up who you are.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Aha... You're so stupid. You literally said 
that already. Get a new line, 
stupid. I just 
can't with your stupidity.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Oh for—No, I really can't!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...No, you did not just say that. What, you think you're like my partner in crime now? Yeah, right!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Seriously! How do you keep it up?! Be 
discouraged for once! Stop 
bothering with 
a pain in the ass like me!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Stupid. Stupid, stupid, stupid. You are so stubborn, and cringe, and weirdly arrogant!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Honestly, what even are you? Oh right, you're my "trainer."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...You really think I could run both roads?
choice_data_list: Let's look for a way together.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... maybe. I guess I just have to keep 
looking.
choice_data_list: Take your time finding the answer.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Stupid. Telling a runner to take things slow? Sigh. I should probably say sorry to my manager.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hah! Oh, I'm dying just picturing it. But no, 
I started this, so what do 
you have to 
apologize for?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Appreciate the sentiment, but I'll do this 
myself. And I'll tell her that, 
well, I've got 
two legs—one for racing, one for 
modeling.
